text.tspan: Option 2 · AWS PrivateLink: B publishes one service, A reaches it through an IP of its own
an ENI in A's own subnet: 10.0.5.20
A only talks to an IP inside A.
Nothing is routed between the VPCs,
Best for 1–2 TCP services, one direction, strong isolation, cross-account. B sees the NLB's IP as the source, not 10.0.1.25
(turn on proxy protocol v2 if the app needs the client IP). One endpoint per service and per direction: B → A needs its own setup.
